scores.round_files_fidelity_rationale: Up from 5.9 because the workspace compiles again (pelco.rs uses command1/command2 with .0). The R64-03/R65-03 ordering is now close to doConnect: loadwpsonconnect waits for ParamsLoaded, the planner read starts first, and the rally ReadMission{2} waits until read_busy() is false, so the connect-time rally fetch no longer replaces the planner's in-flight type-0 read. check_newer_firmware copies MainV2.cs:1703-1725 line by line: Split(' '), fields1[0].ToLower().Contains(VehicleType.ToLower()), ver1 = GetVersion, ver2 = MavFirmwareVersion, ver2 > ver1, 'check the first hit only', and swallowing of every failure. Its GetReleaseNewest emulation is right for an apj-only list: per-MavType groups in first-seen order, the first entry at the group max, and a null max giving no message. Lost: (a) the check reads cs.version_string, which link.rs:1207 fills from AUTOPILOT_VERSION as 'major.minor.patch', not MAV.VersionString (the STATUSTEXT banner, MAVLinkInterface.cs:1859-1862/2017-2020). fields1[0] is then '4.5.0' and never contains a VehicleType, so the check returns None for every real vehicle. At Connected the string is usually still empty. The unit test passes only because it supplies a C#-style banner. (b) parse_manifest's apj filter is applied before GetRelease, which in C# runs over every format with OrderBy(Format), and the CubePilot periph manifest (GetListAppend) is not appended. (c) show_again_allows builds the key with only ' ' and '-' replaced, while Common.MessageShowAgain also replaces '+' and '.', so 'SHOWAGAIN_New_Firmware_Copter_4.5.7' is not C#'s 'SHOWAGAIN_New_Firmware_Copter_4_5_7'. (e) Not gated on showui, it runs before the parameter download instead of after it, and the manifest is downloaded again on every connect instead of using APFirmware's static Manifest. scores.features_rationale: Up 0.1 for the connect ordering. A connect with loadwpsonconnect and RALLY_TOTAL > 0 now fills the planner grid and fetches rally points afterwards, so neither silently cancels the other. Still wrong: the newer-firmware check is wired but dead (wrong VersionString source). loadwps and the rally fetch never run when the parameter download is skipped (skip_params, link.rs:1232), which C# does not depend on. compile_check.summary: Checked every changed file against its definitions. pelco.rs:77: the parameters are now command1: cmd1, command2: cmd2, so they no longer shadow the cs_enum tuple structs. The body uses command1.0/command2.0, and the test's cmd1::None/cmd2::PanLeft are associated consts. R65-01 is resolved. app.rs drain_events: `let Some(link) = &self.link` borrows only self.link. In the Connected arm, self.connection_spec() (&self) runs before `pl = &mut self.settings.planner`. The rate closure reborrows pl immutably and ends before pl.get("loadwpsonconnect"). Assigning self.load_wps_after_params, self.rally_after_read and self.firmware_check, and calling self.toasts.info, are disjoint field borrows while pl and link are live. pl's last use is at 591. ParamsLoaded: std::mem::take(&mut self.load_wps_after_params) and self.rally_after_read are disjoint from link. After the loop, link's last use is at 686 (NLL), so self.settings.view, self.flight_plan.but_read_click(), self.flight_plan.read_busy() and `if let Some(l) = &self.link` are fine. The thread: the move closure captures version_string (String) and tx (crossbeam Sender<Option<(String, String)>>), both Send + 'static. firmware_ui::get is pub(crate) and returns Result<Vec<u8>, String> (firmware_ui.rs:58). gunzip(&[u8]) and parse_manifest(&[u8]) return Result<_, String>, so the and_then chain has one error type and &Vec<u8> deref-coerces. .ok().and_then(|fw| check_newer_firmware(&version_string, &fw)) coerces &Vec<FirmwareInfo> to &[FirmwareInfo]. bounded(1)'s T is inferred from the send and the field. crossbeam-channel is an mp-app dependency (Cargo.toml:22), and firmware_ui is not cfg-gated (lib.rs:10). Line 518: as_ref().and_then(|rx| rx.try_recv().ok()) yields an owned Option<Option<..>>, so assigning self.firmware_check = None afterwards is fine. check_newer_firmware: `String == &str` uses impl PartialEq<&str> for String. types: Vec<&str> borrows through `official`, which outlives the loop. group: Vec<&&FirmwareInfo> from official.iter().filter(..).collect(). ver(f) with f: &&&FirmwareInfo or &&&&FirmwareInfo deref-coerces at the closure call because the closure's parameter is annotated. .max() needs Ord (version.rs:106). Option<Version> == Option<Version> works. `let Some(item) = .. else { continue }` works. contains(&String) is a valid Pattern. GetVersion(..).ok()? and max? work in a fn returning Option. ver2 > ver1 uses PartialOrd (version.rs:100). {ver2} uses Display (86). The module paths are pub: mp_core::fwupload (lib.rs:15), dotnet::version (dotnet/mod.rs:20), extlibs::utilities::versiondetection (utilities/mod.rs:57). Test: br#".."# is &[u8; N] and unsize-coerces to &[u8]. serde ignores unknown fields, and board_id/latest/url default. All four rows are format apj, so parse_manifest keeps them. GetVersion("ArduCopter V4.5.0 (abcdef)") gives the leftmost match '4.5' + '.0', so 4.5.0. 4.5.7 > 4.5.0, so the title is 'New Firmware-Copter 4.5.7'. 'ArduCopter V4.5.7' gives None. For 'ArduPlane V4.3.0', QUADROTOR/Copter does not match and FIXED_WING/Plane does, so the result is 'New Firmware-Plane 4.5.7'. 'ArduCopter' fails GetVersion, so None. The show-again key test agrees with show_again_allows (although both diverge from C#, R66-04). `let mut pl = BTreeMap::new()` is inferred as BTreeMap<String, String> from show_again_allows. flight_plan.rs:525 read_busy reads existing fields. check_newer_firmware has no other caller with the old signature. No definite compile error.

findings.summary: R65-04 is partly fixed. check_newer_firmware itself is a faithful copy of the MainV2 block, but it is fed the wrong string. cs.version_string is set only at link.rs:1207 from AUTOPILOT_VERSION, as 'major.minor.patch' (e.g. '4.5.0'). C#'s MAV.VersionString is the STATUSTEXT banner ('ArduCopter V4.5.0 (abcdef01)'). fields1[0] is therefore never 'ArduCopter'/'ArduPlane', no VehicleType matches, and the function returns None for every real vehicle. At LinkEvent::Connected the string is usually still empty anyway, because the snapshot is taken before AUTOPILOT_VERSION arrives. The feature is wired but dead, and the test hides this by supplying a hand-made C#-style banner. Other divergences: (1) parse_manifest drops every non-apj entry before the GetRelease emulation, while C# groups all formats and takes the first at the max after OrderBy(Format). (2) The CubePilot periph manifest is not appended (GetListAppend). (3) APFirmware's static Manifest is not reused: each connect downloads manifest.json.gz again on a new thread, separately from the Install Firmware page's copy. (4) C# deserialises versions with Newtonsoft (one bad version makes Manifest null and the whole check fail), while Rust skips the bad entries. (5) The check is not gated on showui and runs before getParamList instead of after it. (6) ParameterMetaDataRepositoryAPMpdef.GetMetaDataVersioned(GetVersion(VersionString)) and ConfigArducopter's '>= new Version(4, 7)' branch are still missing.

findings.summary: R65-03 is partly fixed. The read now starts after ParamsLoaded and the rally fetch waits for read_busy() to be false, which matches doConnect's order. Remaining: (1) loadwps and the rally fetch run only on LinkEvent::ParamsLoaded. With skip_params (link.rs:1232) neither ever runs, and with a fresh param cache (C# skips the download) they still wait for the link's full re-download. With Params_BG, C# runs them at once on a background download. (2) A stale awaiting_read is not only a stale tag now. The vehicle-change (link.rs:804) and pending-altitude (link.rs:605) paths emit OperationError, not MissionDownloadFailed, so read_busy() stays true and the deferred rally ReadMission is never sent. The same happens while a finished download sits in pending_download because the user left the Flight Plan view. (3) Every later ParamsLoaded (Config 'Refresh Params') sends ReadMission{2} again, which doConnect never does, and it can still replace a planner read started by hand (no request id, link.rs:641). (4) RALLY_TOTAL uses `p.value as i32`, but C#'s int.TryParse(param.ToString()) rejects 3.5 and 1E+30, which Rust truncates or saturates to a positive count. (5) The view switch skips MenuFlightPlanner_Click -> Activate. (6) '== "True"' instead of bool.TryParse semantics. (7) Geo-Fence/Rally context Downloads still fill lists that C# discards. (8) There is no test of the new ordering, read_busy or the deferred rally fetch.

verdict: The build error is fixed: pelco.rs renames GenerateCommand's parameters, and no other definite compile error was found in the changed code. app.rs's borrows, the crossbeam channel, the thread closure and the rewritten test all type-check, and the test's expectations hold. The connect ordering is now close to doConnect: loadwpsonconnect runs after the parameters, and the rally fetch waits for the planner read, so it no longer cancels it. check_newer_firmware is a faithful line-by-line copy of MainV2's block over a GetReleaseNewest emulation using VersionDetection and System.Version. But it reads cs.version_string, which the link fills from AUTOPILOT_VERSION as '4.5.0' rather than the 'ArduCopter V4.5.0 (...)' banner, so it never matches a real vehicle. The test only passes because it feeds a hand-made banner. The prompt also uses a SHOWAGAIN key that differs from Common.MessageShowAgain's and a plain message box instead of the existing ShowAgain form. Gaps remain in the new gating: no ParamsLoaded (skip_params) means no loadwps and no rally, a stale tag blocks the rally fetch forever, and rally is re-fetched on every parameter refresh. The geofence download and rally-distance warning from doConnect are missing. No owned file was ported. Ported lines stay at 27,302 / 479,014 (5.7%), and the cap stays 1.6. Awarded 1.3 (the build-break deduction is lifted); round-file fidelity 6.0; UI/UX 2.3; features 3.2.
